title: CLIProxyAPI / CPA Prometheus
description: cpa-prometheus plugin: quota windows, credentials (email), and usage.handle traffic. Scrape GET /v0/resource/plugins/cpa-prometheus/metrics. Host GET /metrics stays 404. https://github.com/giovannirco/cpa-prometheus-plugin

panels.title: Plugin up
panels.description: 1 if cpa-prometheus is loaded.

panels.title: Plugin version
panels.description: cliproxy_info plugin_version.

panels.title: Credentials
panels.description: Accounts from host.auth.list matching the filters.

panels.title: Requests in range
panels.description: Completed usage.handle records in the dashboard range.

panels.title: Tokens in range
panels.description: type=total only so input/output/reasoning are not double-counted.

panels.title: Failures in range
panels.description: Failed usage.handle records. Stays 0 until a failure is observed.

panels.title: Last request age
panels.description: Youngest usage.handle timestamp in the filter. Empty until the first request after a restart.

panels.title: Models seen
panels.description: Distinct models observed via usage.handle.

panels.title: Disabled
panels.description: host.auth.list disabled=1.

panels.title: Unavailable
panels.description: host.auth.list unavailable=1.

panels.title: PAYG / no window
panels.description: Credentials with cliproxy_quota_has_window=0 (pay-as-you-go or empty payload).

panels.title: Poll interval
panels.description: Configured quota refresh interval.

panels.title: Quota used
panels.description: 0-1 per account window. Red at 95% used. PAYG accounts with no window do not appear.

panels.title: Quota remaining
panels.description: 1 is unused. Snapshots every quota poll (~5m).

panels.title: Quota used over time
panels.description: Same windows as the gauge, as a history.

panels.title: Time until window reset
panels.description: Seconds until the provider window resets. Negative means the stamp is in the past.

panels.title: Quota windows
panels.description: Per window (provider, email, auth_index, window). has_window lives on the credentials table.

panels.title: Quota fetch errors
panels.description: Isolated per provider. Empty while fetches succeed. Does not take CPA down.

panels.title: Seconds since last successful fetch
panels.description: Should stay near the poll interval. Climbing means fetches are failing.

panels.title: Credentials
panels.description: Per account from host.auth.list. success/failed are host snapshots, not Prom counters. Refresh age is empty when CPA omits last_refresh.

panels.title: Host success / failed (snapshot)
panels.description: CPA host.auth.list counters. These are gauges (latest snapshot), not monotonically increasing Prom counters.

panels.title: Seconds since last request
panels.description: Per provider, model, and credential. Empty until usage.handle fires after a restart.

panels.title: Disabled / unavailable / runtime-only
panels.description: 0/1 gauges from host.auth.list.

panels.title: Cooldown retry (when set)
panels.description: Only present while the credential is cooling down. Empty is healthy.

panels.title: Request rate
panels.description: Completed usage.handle records.

panels.title: Tokens by type
panels.description: Excludes type=total (duplicate of the parts) and type=cached (duplicate of cache_read).

panels.title: Latency p50 / p95
panels.description: From usage.handle duration histogram.

panels.title: Latency heatmap
panels.description: Distribution of request duration buckets. Empty until usage.handle records exist.

panels.title: Failures by code
panels.description: Empty until a failed usage.handle record is observed. code is the HTTP status when CPA provides one.

panels.title: Models observed
panels.description: model_seen is from usage.handle. model_available is emitted only when host.auth.get_runtime includes model_states (often absent on CPA v7).
